newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - May 5.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - May 5.

text.p: * Zytec Corp said on Monday it expected sales for its second quarter ended June 30 to be about 20 percent higher than first quarter sales of $57.6 million, with earnings keeping pace with sales growth. The company also said it expected its third and fourth quarter results to be below those of the second quarter, but sales in the second half would still be somewhat higher than those in the first half.

* James River Corp has agreed to merger with Fort Howard Corp in a stock swap valued at about $3.4 billion or $42.45 a share for Fort Howard shareholders, plus the assumption of debt, the Wall Street Journal said in Monday's electronic edition. James River closed at 30-7/8 and Fort Howard closed at 36-1/2.

* Transitional Hospitals Corp said on Sunday it entered into a definitive merger pact with privately held Select Medical Corp, under which Transitional shareholders would receive $14.55 per share in cash. Shares closed at 10-1/8.
